citations.quote: Name: Hwei. Official role tags: Mage, Support.

Innate: Hwei's damaging abilities mark enemies hit for a short time. Damaging them with a different ability consumes the mark to create an explosion at their location that deals magic damage in an area.

core_mechanics.summary: Different damaging abilities combine to create area magic damage.

cards.purpose: Recognize Hwei's role, damage focus, and spell-combination threat.
cards.title: Hwei

citations.quote: The mark cannot be triggered from the same cast instance of an ability, even if the triggering ability was empowered by Stirring Lights.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Stirring Lights does not let the same cast instance trigger its own mark.

citations.quote: Enemies can be damaged by multiple explosions at once.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Overlapping explosions can damage the same enemy.

citations.quote: Innate: Hwei's damaging abilities mark enemies hit for a short time. Damaging them with a different ability consumes the mark to create an explosion at their location that deals magic damage in an area.

core_mechanics.summary: A different damaging ability consumes a mark to create an area magic-damage explosion.

citations.quote: The explosion occurs around the marked target from where they were when the ability damaged them to consume the mark.
The target who had their mark consumed is able to escape the area of the explosion within the delay period.

core_mechanics.summary: The explosion location is fixed when the mark is consumed, allowing movement out during its delay.

cards.purpose: Recognize the passive burst trigger and the opportunity to leave its explosion.
cards.title: Signature of the Visionary

citations.quote: Spell shield will block an explosion but not the persistent lava damage.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Molten Fissure's explosion and persistent lava interact differently with spell shields.

citations.quote: Wash Brush can only be cast if Hwei has entered a mood, and can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Wash Brush remains usable during cast-inhibiting crowd control.

citations.quote: Active: Hwei enters a disastrous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as Wash Brush. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.
Active: Hwei exits his current mood without incurring its ability cost or cooldown.

core_mechanics.summary: The mood opens its choices and ends on a choice; Wash Brush cancels without the mood's ability cost or cooldown.

citations.quote: Active - QQ: Hwei slings a fireball in the target direction that explodes upon colliding with the first enemy or reaching maximum range, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies.

core_mechanics.summary: QQ is a fireball that explodes on an enemy or at maximum range.

citations.quote: Active - QW: Hwei strikes the target area with a lightning bolt, dealing magic damage to enemies within the area. Isolated or immobilized enemies are dealt increased damage based on their missing health.

core_mechanics.summary: QW is area lightning with missing-health amplification against isolated or immobilized enemies.

citations.quote: Active - QE: Hwei marks a blazing path in a direction that erupts after a delay into explosions. Each explosion deals magic damage and leaves behind a volcanic fissure that continually deals magic damage and slows enemies within.

core_mechanics.summary: QE leaves a persistent damaging and slowing path after delayed explosions.

cards.purpose: Recognize the damage subject and distinguish its related attack choices.
cards.title: Subject: Disaster

citations.quote: Pool of Reflection's shield strength is reduced to 85% for allies.

advanced_exceptions.summary: The pool's shield is weaker for allies than for Hwei.

citations.quote: Active: Hwei enters a serene mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as Wash Brush. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

core_mechanics.summary: The serene mood opens its choices and ends when a choice is cast.

citations.quote: Active - WQ: Hwei forms a current of water in the target direction that grants him and allied champions bonus movement speed and ghosting while within it.

core_mechanics.summary: WQ grants movement speed and ghosting to Hwei and allied champions in its path.

citations.quote: Active - WW: Hwei summons a protective water pool at the target location that grants him and allied champions a shield for a few seconds that increases in strength if they remain within it.

core_mechanics.summary: WW supplies a shield that grows with continued presence in the pool.

citations.quote: Active - WE: Hwei surrounds himself in swirling flares that empower his next 3 basic attacks or ability hits within 9 seconds to each deal bonus magic damage and restore mana.

core_mechanics.summary: WE empowers subsequent attacks or ability hits with bonus magic damage and mana restoration.

cards.purpose: Distinguish his movement path, defensive pool, and empowered-hit effect.
cards.title: Subject: Serenity

citations.quote: Active: Hwei enters a tumultuous mood, gaining access to its abilities as well as Wash Brush. He will exit the mood upon casting any of them.

core_mechanics.summary: The tumultuous mood opens its choices and ends when a choice is cast.

citations.quote: Active - EQ: Hwei launches a terrifying grin in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, knocking them down and fearing and slowing them.

core_mechanics.summary: EQ damages, knocks down, fears, and slows the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: Active - EW: Hwei tosses an eyeball to the target location that expands into a dark gaze, granting sight in a larger area and locking onto the nearest visible enemy champion. The eye then launches itself at the locked-on target, dealing magic damage to the first enemy it collides with, rooting and revealing them.

core_mechanics.summary: EW grants sight, locks onto a visible champion, and fires a projectile that roots and reveals the first enemy hit.

citations.quote: Active - EE: Hwei summons a jaw at the target location that snaps, dealing magic damage to all enemies in the area and applying a decaying slow to them. Enemies that are not standing at the center of the jaw when it snaps are pulled there.

core_mechanics.summary: EE damages and slows an area while pulling off-center enemies into its center.

cards.purpose: Recognize and distinguish his crowd control choices.
cards.title: Subject: Torment

citations.quote: Spell shield can block the aura, explosion, and the application of the first Despair stack.

advanced_exceptions.summary: Spell shields can block the aura, explosion, and initial slow-stack application.

citations.quote: Active: Hwei launches a globule of pure despair in the target direction that collides with the first enemy champion hit, afflicting them with an aura that grows over 3 seconds, reveals the target, and grants sight within its radius.

core_mechanics.summary: The first champion hit carries an expanding aura that reveals them and grants surrounding sight.

citations.quote: Enemies within are continually dealt magic damage and gradually slowed. After the duration ends or when the target dies, the aura explodes to deal magic damage to all enemies within.

core_mechanics.summary: The aura repeatedly damages and slows enemies before exploding at expiry or carrier death.

citations.quote: Spiraling Despair can only be cast if Hwei has not entered a mood.

core_mechanics.summary: The ultimate is available to cast only outside a mood.

cards.purpose: Recognize the ultimate carrier, expanding area threat, and final explosion.
cards.title: Spiraling Despair
